subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI request finish as docs/help coverage for the current pi-tui multiline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a public configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already supports the core multiline editor behavior through pi-tui, but a configurable TUI send shortcut would add a public config/API surface that repository policy treats as product-sensitive.

options.title: Docs/help only
options.body: Document Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback without adding a new config option.

options.title: Add configurable TUI shortcut
options.body: Expose and test an explicit TUI keybinding preference or CLI/config bridge, including upgrade-safe docs and validation.

options.title: Fold into broader editor UX
options.body: Keep this tied to the broader TUI editor ergonomics items such as external editor handoff or vi mode instead of adding a one-off shortcut surface.

recommendation.title: Docs/help only
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback without adding a new config option.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the most recent TUI rewrite and already scoped the remaining product decision in the issue discussion.
